body.statement: For every \(A\subseteq V\), each retained fragment in \(H_A\) is the projection onto rows indexed by \(A\) of at least one tuple in \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)\), distinct fragments at \(A\) project to disjoint nonempty output subsets, and therefore \(|H_A|\le N_{\mathrm{out}}\), \(\sum_{A\subseteq V}|H_A|\le2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}\), and the number of attempted fragment transitions is at most \(p2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}\).
body.justification: The projection charge converts a compact state representation into a total cost controlled by numerical outputs rather than compatible orders.
body.gap: WienobstEtAl2023MECEnumeration, Theorem 4, gives exact-once \(O(n+m)\)-delay bucket-AMO enumeration for graph-distinct outputs, and DeepHuKoutris2021ProjectedEnumeration, Theorem 7, gives output-dependent delay for projected star-query enumeration after linear preprocessing. Neither bounds numerical coefficient fragments in a causal removed-set DAG by the final tuple count.
body.consumer: Sparse or degenerate LiMVAM systems with many compatible orders but few coefficient tuples avoid factorial intermediate storage.
